thread:
auditor (External Auditor): Hi team — during our SOC 2 evidence intake we flagged an API auth outage tied to a key rotation on 2025-01-12. We need the following artifacts for review:
1) KMS/HSM key lifecycle & rotation policy (official doc).
2) Rotation execution logs (CloudTrail & HSM audit) covering last 18 months plus the exact events from 2025-01-12.
3) Access controls and who is allowed to rotate / approve rotations.
4) Evidence that rotation automation ran as expected (lambda run IDs / cron job logs).
5) Incident repro steps and short timeline linking the rotation to the customer-facing auth errors.
Please reply with links to artifacts or a manifest and estimated ETA. Thanks.

marie (Security Eng): Acknowledged — we can assemble this. For the incident tie-in do you want raw CloudTrail + HSM syslog, or a curated packet with highlighted lines?

auditor (External Auditor): Curated packet preferred (searchable archive), but keep raw logs available. Need explicit timestamps and checksums.

josh (Infra): FYI we keep rotation events in CloudTrail and HSM syslogs. Quick queries you can run if needed: 
```
# CloudTrail lookup for KMS API calls around date range
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2025-01-11T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-01-13T00:00:00Z --region us-west-2

# CloudTrail filter for CMK schedule/disable/enable
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh --start-time 2024-07-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-01-12T23:59:59Z
```
HSM syslog (on our bastion): 
```
# grep for rotation-related events (example)
ssh jump@hsm-proxy
sudo zcat /var/log/hsm-audit/*.gz | grep -i "rotate\|key_update\|keystore"
```
I'll stage a curated archive and the raw dumps.

lena (Support): Adding incident notes: ticket INC-2025-0112 — multiple customers reported "authentication failed" and elevated latency 2025-01-12T04:10Z–04:35Z UTC. Short log snippet from API gateway: 
```
2025-01-12T04:12:33Z ERROR auth: InvalidKey for client_id=ck_abc123 request_id=rx-7890
2025-01-12T04:12:34Z WARN token-cache: miss for client_id=ck_abc123
```
We temporarily rolled back to previous key (manual failover) at 04:22Z per runbook, which restored auth. Will include the runbook steps and the revert command we used.

auditor (External Auditor): Follow-up: we also need evidence of separation of duties — list of IAM principals that can modify key policy or initiate rotation, and a snapshot of the key policy at time-of-rotation. Also access review artifacts for the last 12 months.

marie (Security Eng): Understood. Snapshot of key policy at rotation time is available from CloudTrail resource history and we keep key-policy backups in the audit bucket. Separation of duties: key-modify is limited to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-admin and a small SRE group; rotation automation runs under arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-rotate-lambda (no console privileges). Access review doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/access-reviews/2024-q4 (we'll export as PDF).

josh (Infra): I'm exporting the rotation lambda run and the lambda invocation logs. Example Lambda invocation ID from 2025-01-12 rotation: 88a3f9d2-3b4e-4c9a-9a7e-111222333. The lambda log shows it completed, then a downstream HSM commit failed with a transient error code, causing the automation not to complete final tagging — that's consistent with the window reported in support tickets. I'll include the raw invocation log and annotated timeline.

auditor-bot: Uploaded artifact: s3://redwood-internal/audit-packages/2025-01-12/kms-rotation-evidence.tar.gz (sha256: d2c7...f3b1). Contains: curated_logs/, raw_cloudtrail/, hsm_syslogs/, lambda_invocations/, key_policy_snapshots/, support-incident/INC-2025-0112/

auditor (External Auditor): Thanks — can you also confirm retention policy and whether any logs were older than 18 months and thus not available? We need an inventory of missing items if any.

marie (Security Eng): Retention: CloudTrail and KMS key policy archives are retained 24 months. HSM syslogs retained 36 months on the on-prem archive; however, older syslog indexes prior to 2023-06 were rotated to tape and require retrieval (we don't expect that for this request). For the 18-month window you asked for, everything is in the archive.

josh (Infra): For reproducibility, here's the minimal repro steps we'll include in the packet for auditor use: 
1) Identify CMK id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh
2) Re-run the rotation lambda against a staging key (non-prod) with the same HSM commit path.
3) Simulate transient HSM failure by toggling a test-failure flag in hsm-sim, observe the lambda error path and verify rollback behavior.

marie (Security Eng): ETA: curated packet ready by end-of-day PST (2025-02-05 EOD). If you need it sooner we can prioritize and deliver a draft within 4 business hours.

auditor (External Auditor): EOD PST works. Please include a short checklist in the packet: policy, rotation logs, lambda invocations, HSM syslog highlights, access review exports, incident timeline, and checksums. Also include the manual failover command used and the exact timestamp we can reference in the report.

marie (Security Eng): Will do. Adding a quick checklist and manifest to the archive and posting here when upload completes. :white_check_mark: 

auditor (External Auditor): Great, thank you. We'll follow up if we need deeper traces.

auditor-bot: Archive manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-internal/audit-packages/2025-01-12/kms-rotation-evidence-manifest.json (sha256: a9b8...c0d4)

lena (Support): Note for records: INC-2025-0112 closed after manual failover and postmortem scheduled. I'll attach the postmortem link in the packet as well.

marie (Security Eng): Packet uploaded and link DM'd to auditor. Marking this thread resolved for eng-security but will reopen if auditor requests anything else.

auditor (External Auditor): Confirm received the DM and archive. Thanks everyone.
